subject.title: fix(gateway): skip secrets.resolve when target SecretRefs use exec providers

question: Should command-secret resolution skip the gateway RPC for active exec-backed target SecretRefs and resolve them locally when local exec is allowed?
rationale: The code path appears correct for the reported log flood, but the remaining decision is maintainer intent around credentials, local exec, and gateway snapshot semantics rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Accept the guarded local skip
options.body: Land this PR after exact-head refresh, keeping the active-target, inactive-target, and no-local-exec safeguards as intended command-secret behavior.

options.title: Keep gateway-first semantics
options.body: Reject or close this PR and tolerate the current expected `UNAVAILABLE` noise until a gateway-owned resolver contract is designed.

options.title: Require runtime-side redesign
options.body: Supersede this PR with a broader gateway/runtime-command-secret change if maintainers want partial snapshot success instead of CLI preflight skip.

recommendation.title: Accept the guarded local skip
recommendation.body: Land this PR after exact-head refresh, keeping the active-target, inactive-target, and no-local-exec safeguards as intended command-secret behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to `steipete`, and his recent command-secret history makes him the best available owner for the acceptance decision.
